extension.summary: What you watch in Kodi goes into your Movie Night history
extension.description: When you finish a movie or an episode in Kodi, it is added to your history in Movie Night. Open the add-on once to connect: it shows a short code that you enter in Movie Night under Profile, Kodi.
extension.news: 1.0.3: every watch waiting to be sent is kept (no longer only the last 500); a watch Movie Night refuses is shown on the TV, not dropped without a word; Kodi's log no longer names what was watched; a connection that ran out says why (90 days unused, a year, or signed out), on the TV and when the add-on is opened 1.0.2: watches kept while one person was connected never go to another person who connects later 1.0.1: a TV whose connection ran out now says so, instead of still looking connected 1.0.0: first version
